{{Otheruses|Council|more=Spinner}}
The '''Council of Makers and Spinners''' was an organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cmaoli Di/Legends|Cmaoli Di]]. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the council negotiated neutrality between itself, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Buruun]] the Bloodbringer.
